title.en: How to Get an OpenRouter API Key (2026 Step-by-Step Guide)
title.zh: 如何获取 OpenRouter API Key（2026 逐步指南）

excerpt.en: OpenRouter is an AI API aggregator — one key gives you access to OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, and hundreds of other models. Here's how to get started.
excerpt.zh: OpenRouter 是 AI API 聚合平台——一个 Key 即可访问 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek 等数百个模型。以下是上手方法。

en: OpenRouter is an AI API aggregator that provides a unified interface to hundreds of models from different providers. Instead of managing separate API keys for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and DeepSeek, you use one OpenRouter key to access them all.

This simplifies billing, model switching, and fallback strategies. If one provider goes down, you can reroute to another with a one-line code change. OpenRouter also normalizes pricing into a consistent format, making cost comparison easier.
zh: OpenRouter 是一个 AI API 聚合平台，提供统一接口访问来自不同供应商的数百个模型。你不需要为 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 和 DeepSeek 分别管理 API Key，只需一个 OpenRouter Key 即可访问全部。
这简化了计费、模型切换和回退策略。如果某个供应商宕机，你可以用一行代码切换到另一个。OpenRouter 还将定价统一格式化，便于成本对比。

heading.zh: 第 1 步：注册 OpenRouter 账号

en: Go to openrouter.ai and sign up. OpenRouter supports Google and GitHub login for quick onboarding. The registration process takes less than a minute.
After registering, you'll land on the dashboard where you can manage keys, credits, and view usage analytics.
zh: 前往 openrouter.ai 注册。OpenRouter 支持 Google 和 GitHub 登录，快速上手。注册过程不到一分钟。
注册后进入后台，你可以管理 Key、额度和查看用量分析。

heading.zh: 第 2 步：生成 API Key

en: In the dashboard, navigate to the 'Keys' section. Click 'Create Key', give it a name (e.g., 'production' or 'dev'), and copy the generated key. Like most providers, the full key is only shown once.
OpenRouter lets you create multiple keys with different credit limits — useful for separating production and development environments.
zh: 在后台进入「Keys」页面，点击「Create Key」，给它命名（如「production」或「dev」），然后复制生成的 Key。和大多数供应商一样，完整 Key 只显示一次。
OpenRouter 支持创建多个 Key，并设置不同的额度限制——适合区分生产和开发环境。

en: OpenRouter uses a prepaid credits model. Add credits via credit card or crypto. Some models are free (marked in the model list), so you can start experimenting even without payment.
Credits are shared across all models — you don't need separate balances for OpenAI vs Claude. The dashboard shows real-time usage breakdown by model.
zh: OpenRouter 采用预付额度模式。可通过信用卡或加密货币充值。部分模型免费（在模型列表中标记），所以不付款也可以开始实验。
额度在所有模型间共享——不需要为 OpenAI 和 Claude 分别充值。后台显示按模型划分的实时用量。

heading.en: Step 4: Call Multiple Models with One Key
heading.zh: 第 4 步：用一个 Key 调用多个模型

en: OpenRouter's API is OpenAI-compatible. To switch models, just change the model name in your request. Here's an example calling three different providers with the same key:
zh: OpenRouter 的 API 兼容 OpenAI 格式。切换模型只需修改请求中的模型名称。以下是用同一个 Key 调用三个不同供应商的示例：

codeBlocks.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="your-openrouter-api-key",
    base_url="https://openrouter.ai/api/v1"
)

# Call OpenAI GPT-4o
r1 = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="openai/gpt-4o",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)

# Call Anthropic Claude
r2 = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)

# Call Google Gemini
r3 = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="google/gemini-2.0-flash",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)

print(r1.choices[0].message.content)
print(r2.choices[0].message.content)
print(r3.choices[0].message.content)

caption.en: Calling OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini models through OpenRouter with a single API key
caption.zh: 通过 OpenRouter 用一个 API Key 调用 OpenAI、Claude 和 Gemini 模型

en: OpenRouter passes through provider pricing with a small markup. The markup is transparent — shown on each model's page. For high-volume users, the convenience of a single billing system often outweighs the small premium.
Free models are available with rate limits. Paid models are billed per-token, consistent with each provider's original pricing. Check the model list page for real-time pricing.
zh: OpenRouter 在供应商定价基础上加收少量费用。加价透明——在每个模型页面显示。对高用量用户，单一计费系统的便利性通常超过小幅加价。
免费模型有速率限制。付费模型按 token 计费，与各供应商原始定价一致。查看模型列表页面获取实时定价。

answer.en: OpenRouter itself is free to sign up. Some models on the platform are free (rate-limited), while paid models are billed per token. You only pay for what you use.
answer.zh: OpenRouter 注册免费。平台上的部分模型免费（有速率限制），付费模型按 token 计费。你只需为实际使用付费。

question.en: Can I use OpenAI SDK with OpenRouter?
question.zh: 可以用 OpenAI SDK 调用 OpenRouter 吗？

answer.en: Yes. OpenRouter is OpenAI-compatible. Set the base URL to https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 and use your OpenRouter API key. The same code works — just change the model name to include the provider prefix (e.g., 'openai/gpt-4o').
answer.zh: 可以。OpenRouter 兼容 OpenAI 格式。将 base URL 设为 https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 并使用 OpenRouter API Key。代码不变——只需在模型名前加上供应商前缀（如「openai/gpt-4o」）。

question.en: Which models can I access through OpenRouter?
question.zh: 通过 OpenRouter 可以访问哪些模型？

answer.en: Hundreds of models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, DeepSeek, Mistral, and more. The full list is on the OpenRouter models page, including free and paid options with real-time pricing.
answer.zh: 来自 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google、Meta、DeepSeek、Mistral 等供应商的数百个模型。完整列表在 OpenRouter 模型页面，包括免费和付费选项及实时定价。

question.en: Does OpenRouter support streaming and function calling?
question.zh: OpenRouter 支持流式输出和函数调用吗？

answer.en: Yes. OpenRouter supports streaming responses, function calling, and other features where the underlying provider supports them. Feature availability depends on the specific model you choose.
answer.zh: 支持。OpenRouter 支持流式响应、函数调用等功能（前提是底层供应商支持）。功能可用性取决于你选择的具体模型。
